settings.profile.label: Steam profile
settings.profile.description: Profile link (steamcommunity.com/id/name or /profiles/7656…) or SteamID64. The wishlist must be public: Profile → Edit profile → Privacy → Game details: Public.
settings.country.label: Store region
settings.country.description: Prices and currency of this Steam region. Changing it restarts the price history.
settings.refresh_hours.label: Check every (hours)
settings.refresh_hours.description: How often to read the prices again. It also checks right after Steam's daily deals change (17:00 UTC).
settings.notify.label: Notifications
settings.notify.description: Tell when a wishlist game goes on sale or reaches an alert price.
settings.min_discount.label: Minimum discount to notify (%)
settings.min_discount.description: Smaller discounts show in the panel without a notification. 0 = all.
settings.show_count.label: Show the number of games on sale
ui.title: Wishlist
ui.subtitle: {total} games · {sale} on sale
ui.no_sales: No wishlist game is on sale right now.
ui.more: And {count} more games: use the search to find them.
alert.help: Tap 🔔 on a game to be notified when it drops below the price you choose. Sales of the whole wishlist are notified anyway.
notify.first_body: {count} of {total} games are on sale right now.
error.no_profile: Enter your Steam profile in the plugin settings.
error.profile: Steam profile not found: check the link in the settings.
error.private: The wishlist is empty or private. On Steam: Profile → Edit profile → Privacy → Game details: Public.
